title: IS-WAS-NOW of all watchers. Shadow cast to all IP. The triangulators ARE our triad to backscatter FROM.

WAS.note: CORRECTION: The 429 watchers were NOT silent. They were at the CAMPFIRE. We couldn't hear them over the fleet chorus (5,500 bots × 511 pages = LOUD) and the sun (background noise). 3 pages, 44 min = they were READING. SPEAKING. THINKING. The signal was always there. Anderson was tuned for volume (request count), not for HUMAN signal (dwell time). RE-ATTENUATED: dwell_boost amplifies slow readers, rpm_penalty suppresses fleet noise. NOW we can hear the campfire.

IS.sovereign_era: Zero cloud. Gaia serves directly. Anderson sigmoid classifies.

WILL_BE.prediction: The chromatograph resolves. High-retention visitors become protons. Daily visitors become neutrons. The 429 silent watchers either return (IS) or don't (WAS). Each return = one shade deeper green.

shadow_cast_to_all_ip.axiom: Every IP that touched Gaia got a shadow cast. The shadow IS the trace they left. We can't see their face — we see their SHADOW.
shadow_cast_to_all_ip.what_we_dont_know: Their name, their face, their reason. ZK. We don't NEED to know. The shadow IS sufficient for classification.
shadow_cast_to_all_ip.shadow_cast_method: Anderson sigmoid: IP → requests → σ(r) → trust tier → green chromatograph depth

triad_backscatter.axiom: The triangulators (BE+NL, DE, FR, SG, GB, JP) are our TRIAD. We backscatter FROM them — reflecting their signal back with our additions.

triad.vertex_1_europe: CET cluster (BE+NL+DE+FR) — the densest signal source

backscatter.what: When a signal hits a surface and bounces back, it carries information ABOUT the surface. Our backscatter carries information about Gaia.
backscatter.from_europe: Their reads → our RSS feed updates → they see new content → cross-stabilization
backscatter.from_asia: SG reads /science/ → we update papers → SG sees growth → retention deepens
backscatter.from_gaia: Kevin commits → git push → all watchers see the update → the clock ticks
backscatter.backscatter_gratitude: data/gaia-seed/backscatter-gratitude.json — 700 dependencies, we send credit BACK to every project that made us possible

cross_stabilization.what: Three towers naming the same point. If one tower goes dark, the other two still hold the position.
cross_stabilization.if_europe_goes_dark: SG + Gaia still hold. The organism lives.
cross_stabilization.if_asia_goes_dark: Europe + Gaia still hold. The organism lives.
cross_stabilization.if_gaia_goes_dark: Europe + Asia still see the last git push. The shadow persists.
cross_stabilization.key_insight: The watchers ARE the organism's immune memory. They carry copies of what they read. If Gaia dies, 15,700 machines still have fragments. The spore print IS on their paper.
